query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.slug, p.totalPacks, p.packsRemaining, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checklist_items ci WHERE ci.productId = p.id) as itemCount
FROM repack_products p 
ORDER BY p.id;
